selection_rule: Fold 0 is the top-level alias because it is the clearest explainability/PnL compromise: meaningful W4/W10/W20 use, some cash/exits, zero invalid actions, positive eval-to-test transfer, and it beats the paper rule. Fold 3 has higher held-out PnL and is kept in the fold bundle, but its behavior is more W6-dominant.

interpretability_notes.fold0: Best shipped explanation fold: W4/W10/W20 all used meaningfully, some cash/exits, beats paper, strong positive PnL.
interpretability_notes.fold1: Positive PnL, but W6-dominant and less interesting as an autonomous-width story.
interpretability_notes.fold2: Positive PnL, but loses to the paper rule on its test window.
interpretability_notes.fold3: Highest-PnL alternate fold, but more W6-dominant than fold0; kept as a strong comparison checkpoint.
